title: Predict choice based on patient characteristics and family values — predict
text: expected_los Expected additional ICU length stay. Use one following (Default = 0): clinical_situation Clinical Situation. Use one following (Default = 0): age Age. Use one following (Default = 0): frailty Frailty hospital admission. Use one following (Default = 0): life_expectancy Life expectancy (pre-admission). Use one following (Default = 0): suffering Burden Suffering. Use one following (Default = 0): disability_cardiovascular Expected cardiovascular impairment discharge. Use one following (Default = 0): disability_pulmonary Expected pulmonary impairment discharge. Use one following (Default = 0): disability_renal Expected renal impairment discharge. Use one following (Default = 0): disability_neurological Expected neurological impairment discharge. Use one following (Default = 0): disability_gastrointestinal Expected gastrointestinal impairment discharge. Use one following (Default = 0): family_values Patient Family Values. Use one following (Default = 0): type Either "binary" "multinomial". Default: "binary". group Either "aggregate", "aumc", "olvg", "intensivists" "fellows". Default: "aggregate"
